summary: This directory centralizes error handling and reporting for the TypeScript analysis pipeline. It defines structured error types and contextual metadata to allow for granular diagnostics when failures occur during specific phases of the analysis process.
responsibilities: Defining standard error structures for the analysis pipeline
Providing contextual information for analysis failures
Classifying errors by the specific phase in which they occurred
relationships: The AnalysisError class utilizes the AnalysisErrorContext to provide metadata about where and when a failure occurred.
The AnalysisPhase enum categorizes the specific stage of the pipeline associated with an AnalysisError.
designDecisions: Usage of a dedicated error class to encapsulate analysis-specific failure details
Implementation of an interface to enforce consistent context requirements across different error scenarios
